scenario: Workout with a GPS route chunk and an intra-workout series chunk
notes: One workout sample with per-type statistics, events, and a sub-activity; one route line with two GPS fixes (the second with explicit-null optional fields); one heart-rate series line with two points. Route and series lines reference the workout by its upper-case UUID, and the workout, its lap event and every point carry fractional epoch-ms timestamps, as the app sends them.
